title: High-velocity purchases of stored-value instruments
definition: A pattern of purchases of stored-value or prepaid instruments at a high rate, often in repeated rounded amounts and from several points of sale, with rapid subsequent use. The indicator measures the velocity and the use pattern.
evidence_to_cite: the purchase records and the redemption records
the merchant category codes of the points of sale
the source of the funds used to buy the instruments, where known
benign_explanations: A retailer that sells stored-value cards as its own product line.
A consumer preparing for an event, holiday or celebration.
An employer distributing incentive or welfare vouchers on a scheduled cycle.
A business running a promotional discount funded by prepaid cards.

sources.citation: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, guidance on money services businesses and prepaid access, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
